B09.title: Minimal Query Bindings and Metadata Definitions
B09.boundary_and_ownership: Own minimal query-operation ABI descriptors and query owner IDs under Query.Binding/native/database/binding. Import canonical metadata/value/result shapes from B01; do not publish another Table/Column schema or a serialized C# SQL AST.
B09.native_reuse: Versioned calls target SeaQuery-native builder operations. Start with direct native operations; batching is an optional measured encoding optimization with identical semantics, not a prerequisite or second query language.
B09.csharp_surface: Internal typed call descriptors and owner/alias tokens used by B10/B11/B13, with public application types from B01.
implementation_steps: Define direct operation contracts for query create, predicates/joins/projection/order/limit, seal and execute plan reference, plus capability errors and legal state transitions.
Distinguish synchronous borrowed parameter input from copied/owned async arguments. A business descriptor hash is content identity, not Engine ABI fingerprint.
Bind owner identity and alias/type metadata to each operation. Raw ABI validation repeats type/capability/size checks; C# generics are not the only protection.
If implementing batches later, retain finite version/node/depth/bytes and prevalidate all operations before applying; failure cannot leave an executable partly mutated AST.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: Reject unknown opcode/capability/version, wrong owner, reused/disposed owner and overflow before mutation.
Use Core D08 statuses and bounded structured domain detail; do not export a new generic runtime object/trait abstraction.
specific_acceptance: Double-sided ABI/signature and operation golden fixtures; direct operation state/property negatives without needing a real DB.
If a batch path is added, same direct oracle SQL+parameters+errors and all-or-nothing validation; no benchmark claim without measured evidence.
B09.dependency_rationale: Add B01 start dependency because it owns canonical metadata and value/row contracts. B09 stays independent of B11 implementation and of whole database host.

B10.title: Optional Static Descriptor and DTO Generation
B10.boundary_and_ownership: Own optional incremental generator, its diagnostic fixtures and generated-output golden files only. B01/B09 own input contracts; B12 owns runtime/static reader behavior. Do not require this generator for ordinary querying.
B10.native_reuse: Roslyn incremental APIs only for static C# metadata/constructor emission; native SeaQuery/SQLx are unchanged application-independent assets.
B10.csharp_surface: Opt-in model/projection declarations emit immutable descriptors and static materializers equivalent to handwritten forms; direct C# constructor access is AOT-visible.
implementation_steps: Filter syntax then resolve explicit symbols; output deterministic fully-qualified names and ordering. No database connection, network, Cargo, source checkout or native compilation in generator execution.
Emit supported codec/nullability/key/alias/constructor descriptors and static DTO readers using B12 contract; closed generics/JsonTypeInfo are explicit.

Implement the complete D17 NWQ0101-NWQ0107 family with exact locations and meanings, including NWQ0107 for mappings requiring dynamic code or unbounded reflective discovery. Preserve historical old diagnostic numbers rather than repurposing them; test every diagnostic with a compile-negative fixture.
Handle incremental invalidation for relevant model changes and stable unrelated changes. Do not rely on another generator output appearing in the same pass.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: Unsupported constructor/codec/type/nullability fails clearly with handwritten alternative only when it truly supports that model; no reflection fallback.
Generated materialization always scopes the owned batch lease; constructor exceptions follow B12 cleanup.
specific_acceptance: Real compile success/failure and deterministic output tests, partial types/nullable/constructor cases, incremental unchanged-output assertions.
Generated and handwritten same metadata/result DTO on Windows/Linux AOT and two supported entities with exact unchanged native SHA; B13 integration is acceptance, not generator start gate.
B10.dependency_rationale: Preserve local implementation prerequisites; run composition acceptance with actual providers without blocking unrelated implementation work.

B11.title: Rust SeaQuery Deep Binding and Capability Checks
B11.boundary_and_ownership: Own actual SeaQuery AST/builder/capability checking and managed narrow binding adapter; call B07 for Arguments conversion. B09 owns operation declaration, B13 application Fluent composition.
B11.native_reuse: SeaQuery Expr/Condition/Select/Insert/Update/Delete/Dialect and SQLx B07 binder. No C# SQL parser/emitter, no duplicated Rust SQL builder.
B11.csharp_surface: Internal native query/plan owner and typed operation calls; public high-level Fluent surface is B13.
implementation_steps: Implement Mutable→Sealed→Submitted/Closed/Poisoned with single-writer admission. Immutable sealed shape and each execution parameter snapshot are distinct owners.
Translate typed metadata/operations directly into SeaQuery public APIs; retain metadata owner and aliases. Value placeholders remain values, identifiers come from trusted metadata.

Validate backend capabilities before SeaQuery render and before send: reject SQLite row lock/SELECT INTO/SEARCH CYCLE, unsupported CTE/ANY/SOME/ALL or named-window cardinality instead of accepting upstream ignore/panic.
Implement ordinary CRUD, joins, aggregates, bounded subqueries/CTE/window capabilities with SQL three-valued logic; call B07 once for native binding and propagate its error.
Cache immutable compiled shapes only under finite entries/bytes and exact ABI/profile/metadata/query keys. Eviction retains in-use owners; no cache of mutable argument buffers.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: Cross-query expression/alias transfer requires explicit native clone or rejection, never pointer reuse; Dispose races are admission failures.
Seal failure is either no mutation/retryable or explicit Poisoned; caught panic cannot leave a valid-looking partially changed builder.
No client-side hidden expression evaluation or C# NULL compensation.
specific_acceptance: For every supported operation compare direct Rust SeaQuery SQL, placeholder order, typed arguments and real PG/SQLite result/errors against C#→ABI.
Property/negative tests: malformed raw operations, SQL injection through value vs identifier, nonfinite/overflow values, NULL joins, Unicode, empty sets, capability mismatches and budget exhaustion.
Same-native-hash ordinary entity changes and Windows/Linux AOT, with fallible binder source owned by B07 only.
B11.dependency_rationale: Add B07 to start because B11 must consume one codec/binder implementation rather than duplicate it. B09 provides query/metadata binding; actual providers and host gate composition acceptance only.

B12.title: Static C# DTO Materialization and Exception Cleanup
B12.boundary_and_ownership: Own static managed typed readers and DTO construction/runtime contract. Read B01 row-lease interface and B07 scalar conversion; B06 owns batch allocation/cursor implementation, B10 optional emitted constructor code.
B12.native_reuse: Native provider/codec computes typed result values and shape; C# maps that finite representation directly to application DTOs. SeaORM dynamic projection is optional inside Rust and must obey identical shape checks.
B12.csharp_surface: Static RowReader<T>/projection constructor interface, typed scalar access and lease scope; no identity map, reflection setter, arbitrary runtime generic instantiation or managed relation graph.
implementation_steps: Validate expected shape count/order/IDs/alias/type/nullability before nullable getters. SeaORM Option<T> can map a missing SQLx column to None; guard that native path too.
Generate/implement direct typed scalar reads and constructor/member assignment. SQL NULL in a present nullable column is distinct from missing shape and from a nonnullable failure.
Scope every borrowed view to the owned batch lease; copying a retained CLR string/array is explicit. Do not return an escaping Span backed by already-released native memory.
Wrap constructor/setter/JSON reader exceptions in finally cleanup; cursor close and protocol cleanup remain asynchronous owners and are not abandoned on mapping failure.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: Wrong type/shape, narrowing/precision failure or constructor throw is a typed mapping failure with no partially published DTO result collection.
Task completion/early enumeration stop does not prematurely release batch or parent; cancellation invokes the same B06 cleanup flow.
specific_acceptance: Handwritten independent oracle checks missing nullable field, duplicate alias, wrong type, nonnullable NULL and throwing constructor; then same oracle validates generated materializers.
Actual two-provider AOT enumeration and NuGet consumer; owner/allocation accounting for every failure path.
B12.dependency_rationale: Keep start B07/B09: B01 row-lease contract is transitively available and a local fixture can implement it. Actual B06 ownership and providers must pass composition before acceptance, without forcing B10 first.

B13.title: Strongly Typed Runtime Fluent Native Queries
B13.boundary_and_ownership: Own natural application-facing typed Fluent calls/proxies under Query.Fluent; no persistent managed SQL tree. B11 owns builder, B09 operation descriptors, B12 DTO materialization.
B13.native_reuse: Direct SeaQuery builder calls and shared runtime metadata; optional batching only if supported by B09 with measured benefit.
B13.csharp_surface: Query<TEntity>, typed columns, scoped aliases/expressions, typed Select<TDto>, async execute/stream; handwritten and SG metadata are equivalent paths.
implementation_steps: Map every Fluent operation to the native owner immediately; retain only typed owner/descriptor/proxy references required by the user interface.
Snapshot each value at its documented call or submit point, before await; do not reread mutable closures. Reused query shapes take new isolated parameter owners.
Enforce query/alias/entity/value type association, explicit IS NULL/IS NOT NULL and deterministic page tie-breakers; dynamic external fields resolve metadata allowlist and native validation.

Connect seal/execute/cursor and DTO projection without assuming generator availability. Unsupported constructs fail with structured capability diagnostics, never fall back to a hidden managed LINQ engine.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: Concurrent mutations, mutation after Seal, cross-query proxy, wrong backend, parent closing and repeated dispose are explicit errors with preserved resource safety.
Enumeration mapping failure or cancellation releases current batch then completes cursor/session cleanup through B06/B04.
specific_acceptance: Compile negatives for wrong TEntity/TValue/alias use; runtime wrong-owner and disposed query negatives; closure value mutation before/after snapshot oracle.
Real filter/order/limit, explicit join, aggregate, CTE/window capability and projection examples in clean Windows/Linux NuGet consumers; same native hash for new supported entities.
Record direct-operation call/copy costs for B23; no zero-overhead or full EF compatibility acceptance claim.

B14.title: Rust Explicit Relationship CRUD and Optimistic Concurrency
B14.boundary_and_ownership: Own explicit native relation/CRUD/CAS policy and narrow C# changeset surface. No implicit lazy loading, identity map, tracking or aggregate save-graph semantics added silently.
B14.native_reuse: SeaQuery joins/CRUD and SQLx transactional execution for the ordinary route. SeaORM LoaderTrait offers valuable native batching/grouping but has static ModelTrait/EntityTrait bounds and all() materialization; dynamic eager loading requires an explicit upstream/native adapter scope with bounded grouping, not a C# relation engine.
B14.csharp_surface: Explicit typed relation projections, Change<T> with NotSet/Null/Value, tenant/key/version CAS, and transaction-scoped operation results.
implementation_steps: Build joins and projections from explicit relationship metadata; distinguish an unmatched LEFT JOIN row via a nonnullable joined key/null marker rather than a nullable business column alone.
Implement NotSet as omitted update column, Null as bound SQL NULL and Value as bound checked value. Construct tenant+key+version predicates in native code before execution.
Perform CAS update with version increment, inspect affected rows and return conflict without automatic write replay. Multiple statements use B05 transaction scope.

Expose explicit bulk/relationship batches within finite parent/key/result budgets. Initial ordinary baseline supports joins and explicit batches; do not claim SeaORM eager loader is already dynamic or bounded.

Any optional dynamic native loader extension must cite the existing SeaORM algorithm/license/pin, prove parent order/duplicate/null/many-to-many semantics and stay separate from basic CRUD acceptance.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: Tenant scope is never removed by keyset cursor, relation path or recovery query. Composite keys and duplicate parent rows have explicit deterministic handling.
CAS conflict differs from encoding error, missing row and Unknown commit. Cancellation after write dispatch follows B05, not a fictional rollback guarantee.
Partial changesets and failed multi-statement updates cannot publish success or leak held parent/cursor/transaction owners.
specific_acceptance: Use actual native LEFT JOIN/count/sum and tenant CAS Design oracle cases, plus duplicate/composite parent keys, absent child and NULL fields on both real providers.
Concurrent same-version writers: one success and one conflict; cross-tenant negative; rollback failure/COMMIT Unknown propagation and no blind retry.
Static DTO and handwritten/generated metadata parity on AOT with unchanged native asset; any optional loader is evaluated separately by explicit coverage.
B14.dependency_rationale: Preserve local implementation prerequisites; run composition acceptance with actual providers without blocking unrelated implementation work.
